findings.message: The form dadosMinimosForm submits salvarMeusDados but no state has salvarMeusDados.input as its source. Added the salvarMeusDadosDraft state (SalvarMeusDadosDraft) with setSalvarMeusDadosDraft.

The entry param pessoaOrganizacaoId (select:meuCadastroResumo) has no state and no selection method. Added the persisted state pessoaOrganizacaoId, the getter meuCadastroResumo (the loaded registration when the id matches or none is selected) and selectMeuCadastroResumo(id). No query fetches a record by id, so selection resolves only against the loaded registration.
The form text mentions an optional phone, but salvarMeusDados has no phone input field. The draft does not hold it.
salvarMeusDados returns meuCadastro, which has no declared source state of its own; it was applied to meuCadastro, the state fed by qryMeuCadastro.
public meuCadastroResumo is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
